description.content: Use this REST API to retrieve the data from an application composition report, that is generated after an evaluation.

By configuring Lifecycle with SCM, policy evaluations can be linked to the Git commit hash. Use this method to compare the violations between policy evaluations for 2 commits, by providing the linked commit hashes.

Permissions required: View IQ Elements

query.description: (Required) Enter the commit hash linked to the earlier policy evaluation.
(Required) Enter the commit hash linked to the other (later) policy evaluation to compare.
Enter the policy evaluation Id linked to the earlier policy evaluation to compare
Enter the policy evaluation Id linked to the other (later) policy evaluation to compare
Set to true to include policy violation times (open, legacy, waived, fixed) in the response if set.

variable.description: (Required) Enter the applicationPublicId, created at the time of creating the application

response.name: The response contains the violation details grouped under addedViolations, sameViolations and removedViolations for the two policy evaluations being compared.

Use this method to retrieve the dependencies related to the component identified at the time of application evaluation. This is currently available only for Java (Maven) and NPM applications.

Permissions required: View IQ Elements

variable.description: (Required) Enter the applicationPublicId created at the time of creating the application.
(Required)  Enter the reportId (scanId) created at the time of evaluating the application.

response.name: The response fields contain the 'Dependency Tree' data  under the 'children' section. The 'children' section may contain more tree nodes. Every direct dependency can have zero or more transitive dependencies. Each tree node contains the packageUrl, component identifier and a dependency tree node (if it exists.) The component identifier section contains the format and coordinates for the component.
